blurb: A tree of all of mathematics from foundations to applications: areas, theorems, conjectures, objects, methods and history.

nodes.name: Foundations and logic
nodes.what: The study of mathematical reasoning itself: logic, sets, computability, proof and the structures that underlie all other areas.

children.name: Mathematical logic
children.what: Formal languages, proofs and truth in structures.

children.name: Propositional logic
children.what: Logic of true/false statements joined by connectives.
children.law: p ∧ q, p ∨ q, ¬p, p → q

children.name: Truth table
children.what: Tabulates the truth value of a formula for every assignment of its variables.

children.name: Completeness of propositional logic
children.what: Every tautology is provable in the standard calculus.

children.name: Compactness theorem (propositional)
children.what: A set of formulas is satisfiable iff every finite subset is.

children.name: SAT problem
children.what: Decide if a Boolean formula has a satisfying assignment.

children.name: First-order logic
children.what: Logic with quantifiers over individuals, predicates and functions.

children.name: Gödel completeness theorem
children.what: A first-order sentence is provable iff it is true in every model.

children.name: Compactness theorem
children.what: A first-order theory has a model iff every finite part does.

children.name: Löwenheim–Skolem theorem
children.what: A theory with an infinite model has models of every larger cardinality and countable ones.

children.name: Skolem's paradox
children.what: Set theory has countable models although it proves uncountable sets exist.

children.name: Church's theorem
children.what: First-order validity is undecidable.

children.name: Resolution
children.what: Refutation-complete inference rule used in automated theorem proving.

children.name: Craig interpolation
children.what: If φ → ψ is valid there is a θ in their common vocabulary with φ → θ → ψ.

children.name: Higher-order and modal logic
children.what: Logics with quantification over predicates or with necessity and possibility operators.

children.name: Second-order logic
children.what: Quantifies over subsets and relations; strong but lacks completeness.

children.name: Modal logic
children.what: Adds □ (necessarily) and ◇ (possibly) operators.

children.name: Kripke semantics
children.what: Possible-worlds semantics for modal logic.

children.name: Temporal logic
children.what: Modal logic about time, used in program verification.

children.name: Intuitionistic and constructive logic
children.what: Logic without the law of excluded middle.

children.name: Curry–Howard correspondence
children.what: Proofs correspond to programs and propositions to types.

children.name: Heyting arithmetic
children.what: Intuitionistic version of Peano arithmetic.

children.name: Brouwer–Heyting–Kolmogorov interpretation
children.what: Meaning of connectives via what counts as a proof.

children.name: Set theory
children.what: The theory of collections; the standard foundation for mathematics.

children.name: Naive set theory and cardinality
children.what: Sets, functions, relations, countable and uncountable infinities.

children.name: Cantor's theorem
children.what: Every set is strictly smaller than its power set.

children.name: Cantor's diagonal argument
children.what: The real numbers are uncountable.

children.name: Countability of the rationals
children.what: The rationals are in bijection with the naturals.

children.name: Cantor–Bernstein–Schroeder theorem
children.what: Injections both ways between two sets give a bijection.

children.name: Aleph numbers
children.what: Cardinals of infinite well-ordered sets.

children.name: Cardinal arithmetic
children.what: Sum, product and exponentiation of cardinals.

children.name: Ordinal numbers
children.what: Order types of well-ordered sets, extending counting past infinity.

children.name: Cantor normal form
children.what: Every ordinal below ε₀ is a finite sum of decreasing powers of ω.

children.name: Zermelo–Fraenkel axioms
children.what: The standard axiom system ZF for sets.

children.name: Axiom of extensionality
children.what: Sets with the same members are equal.

children.name: Axiom of pairing
children.what: For any a, b the set {a, b} exists.

children.name: Axiom of union
children.what: The union of a set of sets is a set.

children.name: Axiom of power set
children.what: Every set has a set of all its subsets.

children.name: Axiom of infinity
children.what: An infinite set exists.

children.name: Axiom schema of separation
children.what: Any definable subclass of a set is a set.

children.name: Axiom schema of replacement
children.what: The image of a set under a definable function is a set.

children.name: Axiom of regularity
children.what: Every non-empty set has an ∈-minimal element, forbidding x ∈ x.

children.name: Axiom of choice
children.what: Every family of non-empty sets has a choice function.

children.name: Zorn's lemma
children.what: A poset where every chain has an upper bound has a maximal element.

children.name: Well-ordering theorem
children.what: Every set can be well-ordered.

children.name: Banach–Tarski paradox
children.what: A ball can be cut into pieces and reassembled into two balls of the same size.

children.name: Independence of the axiom of choice
children.what: AC is neither provable nor refutable in ZF.

children.name: Tychonoff's theorem
children.what: Any product of compact spaces is compact (equivalent to AC).

children.name: Continuum hypothesis
children.what: There is no set strictly between the naturals and the reals in size.

children.name: Gödel's constructible universe L
children.what: Inner model satisfying AC and CH, proving CH is consistent.

children.name: Cohen forcing
children.what: Method building models where CH fails, proving CH independent of ZFC.

children.name: Martin's axiom
children.what: Axiom implying CH-like behaviour for sets of size below the continuum.

children.name: Large cardinals and determinacy
children.what: Strong axioms of infinity that extend ZFC.

children.name: Inaccessible cardinal
children.what: Uncountable regular strong limit cardinal; models ZFC.

children.name: Measurable cardinal
children.what: Cardinal carrying a nontrivial countably complete ultrafilter.

children.name: Woodin cardinal
children.what: Large cardinal central to determinacy theory.

children.name: Axiom of determinacy
children.what: Every two-player infinite game on naturals is determined.

children.name: Martin's theorem on Borel determinacy
children.what: Every Borel game is determined.

children.name: Descriptive set theory
children.what: Study of definable sets of reals such as Borel and analytic sets.

children.name: Suslin's problem
children.what: Is a dense linear order with ccc necessarily separable? Independent of ZFC.

children.name: Paradoxes
children.what: Contradictions in naive set theory.

children.name: Russell's paradox
children.what: The set of all sets not containing themselves is contradictory.

children.name: Burali-Forti paradox
children.what: The set of all ordinals would be an ordinal larger than itself.

children.name: Cantor's paradox
children.what: The set of all sets would have a power set bigger than itself.

children.name: Alternative set theories
children.what: Foundations differing from ZFC.

children.name: Von Neumann–Bernays–Gödel set theory
children.what: Conservative extension of ZFC with proper classes.

children.name: New Foundations
children.what: Quine's set theory with a stratified comprehension schema.

children.name: Kripke–Platek set theory
children.what: Weak set theory used in admissible set theory.

children.name: Model theory
children.what: Study of mathematical structures via the first-order theories they satisfy.

children.name: Elementary equivalence and types
children.what: Structures satisfying the same sentences; types describe elements.

children.name: Łoś's theorem
children.what: Ultraproducts satisfy exactly the sentences true on a large set of factors.

children.name: Ultraproduct
children.what: Quotient of a product of structures by an ultrafilter.

children.name: Quantifier elimination
children.what: Every formula is equivalent to a quantifier-free one in certain theories.

children.name: Tarski–Seidenberg theorem
children.what: Real closed fields admit quantifier elimination.

children.name: Robinson's consistency theorem
children.what: Joint consistency of theories with a complete common part.

children.name: Categoricity and stability
children.what: Classification of theories by number of models.

children.name: Łoś–Vaught test
children.what: A theory categorical in some infinite power with no finite models is complete.

children.name: Morley's categoricity theorem
children.what: A countable theory categorical in one uncountable power is categorical in all.

children.name: Stability theory
children.what: Classifies theories by how many types they have.

children.name: Vaught's conjecture
children.what: A countable complete theory has either at most countably many or continuum many countable models.

children.name: Nonstandard analysis
children.what: Rigorous infinitesimals via ultrapowers of the reals.

children.name: Hyperreal numbers
children.what: Ordered field extending the reals with infinitesimal and infinite elements.

children.name: Transfer principle
children.what: First-order statements hold for reals iff they hold for hyperreals.

children.name: O-minimality and applications
children.what: Tame geometry of definable sets; applications to Diophantine problems.

children.name: Ax–Grothendieck theorem
children.what: An injective polynomial map of complex affine space is surjective.

children.name: Mordell–Lang for function fields
children.what: Model-theoretic proof of a case of Mordell–Lang.

children.name: Pila–Wilkie theorem
children.what: Counts rational points on transcendental definable sets.

children.name: Proof theory
children.what: Study of formal proofs as mathematical objects.

children.name: Natural deduction and sequent calculus
children.what: Proof systems with introduction/elimination rules.

children.name: Cut elimination
children.what: Any sequent proof can be converted to one without the cut rule.

children.name: Subformula property
children.what: Cut-free proofs only use subformulas of the conclusion.

children.name: Consistency and ordinal analysis
children.what: Measure strength of theories by ordinals.

children.name: Gentzen's consistency proof for PA
children.what: PA is consistent by transfinite induction up to ε₀.

children.name: Proof-theoretic ordinal
children.what: Supremum of recursive ordinals a theory can prove well-ordered.

children.name: Reverse mathematics
children.what: Determines which axioms are needed to prove theorems of ordinary mathematics.

children.name: Big five subsystems
children.what: RCA₀, WKL₀, ACA₀, ATR₀, Π¹₁-CA₀ calibrate most theorems.

children.name: Incompleteness phenomena
children.what: Limits of formal provability.

children.name: Gödel's first incompleteness theorem
children.what: Any consistent effective theory containing arithmetic has true unprovable statements.

children.name: Gödel's second incompleteness theorem
children.what: Such a theory cannot prove its own consistency.

children.name: Tarski's undefinability theorem
children.what: Arithmetical truth is not definable in arithmetic.

children.name: Löb's theorem
children.what: If T proves (Prov(φ) → φ) then T proves φ.

children.name: Paris–Harrington theorem
children.what: A natural Ramsey-type statement true but unprovable in Peano arithmetic.

children.name: Goodstein's theorem
children.what: Every Goodstein sequence reaches 0, unprovable in PA.

children.name: Rosser's trick
children.what: Strengthens Gödel's theorem using only simple consistency.

children.name: Peano arithmetic
children.what: First-order axioms for the natural numbers with induction.

children.name: Induction schema
children.what: If φ(0) and φ(n) → φ(n+1) hold then φ holds for all n.

children.name: Presburger arithmetic
children.what: Arithmetic with addition only; complete and decidable.

children.name: Robinson arithmetic Q
children.what: Finitely axiomatised weak arithmetic that is already essentially undecidable.

children.name: Computability theory
children.what: Which functions can be computed by algorithms.

children.name: Models of computation
children.what: Formal definitions of algorithm.

children.name: Turing machine
children.what: Abstract machine with a tape and finite control.

children.name: Lambda calculus
children.what: Function abstraction and application as a model of computation.

children.name: Recursive functions
children.what: Functions built from primitive recursion, composition and minimisation.

children.name: Church–Turing thesis
children.what: Intuitively computable functions are exactly the Turing computable ones.

children.name: Universal Turing machine
children.what: One machine that simulates every other.

children.name: Register machine
children.what: Counter machine model equivalent to Turing machines.

children.name: Post correspondence problem
children.what: Undecidable matching problem on strings.

children.name: Undecidability
children.what: Problems no algorithm can solve.

children.name: Halting problem
children.what: No algorithm decides whether a program halts.

children.name: Rice's theorem
children.what: Every nontrivial semantic property of programs is undecidable.

children.name: Entscheidungsproblem
children.what: No algorithm decides first-order validity.

children.name: Hilbert's tenth problem
children.what: No algorithm decides solvability of Diophantine equations.

children.name: Word problem for groups
children.what: No algorithm decides whether a word in a finitely presented group is trivial.

children.name: Busy beaver function
children.what: Fastest-growing function that bounds halting programs; uncomputable.

children.name: Kolmogorov complexity
children.what: Length of the shortest program that outputs a string; uncomputable.

children.name: Chaitin's constant Ω
children.what: Halting probability of a universal prefix machine; algorithmically random.

children.name: Degrees and hierarchies
children.what: Classification of unsolvable problems by relative difficulty.

children.name: Turing degrees
children.what: Equivalence classes of sets under Turing reducibility.

children.name: Friedberg–Muchnik theorem
children.what: There exist incomparable computably enumerable degrees.

children.name: Post's problem
children.what: Is there a c.e. set strictly between computable and the halting set?

children.name: Arithmetical hierarchy
children.what: Classifies sets by quantifier alternation.

children.name: Kleene recursion theorem
children.what: Programs can access their own code.

children.name: Ackermann function
children.what: Total computable function not primitive recursive.

children.name: Category theory
children.what: Mathematics of objects and structure-preserving maps, a unifying language.

children.name: Basic notions
children.what: Categories, functors and natural transformations.

children.name: Category
children.what: Objects, morphisms, composition and identities.

children.name: Functor
children.what: Structure-preserving map between categories.

children.name: Natural transformation
children.what: Morphism between functors.

children.name: Yoneda lemma
children.what: Nat(Hom(A,−),F) ≅ F(A); objects are determined by their maps.

children.name: Equivalence of categories
children.what: Weak notion of sameness for categories.

children.name: Universal constructions
children.what: Limits, colimits and adjunctions.

children.name: Limits and colimits
children.what: Universal cones and cocones over diagrams.

children.name: Adjoint functors
children.what: Pair of functors with Hom(FA,B) ≅ Hom(A,GB).

children.name: Adjoint functor theorem
children.what: Gives conditions for a functor to have an adjoint.

children.name: Monad
children.what: Endofunctor with unit and multiplication; algebraic structure.

children.name: Kan extension
children.what: Best approximation of a functor along another.

children.name: Higher and topos theory
children.what: Categories with higher morphisms and category-like universes.

children.name: Topos
children.what: Category behaving like sets, with internal logic.

children.name: Elementary topos
children.what: Cartesian closed category with subobject classifier.

children.name: Grothendieck topos
children.what: Category of sheaves on a site.

children.name: Infinity-category
children.what: Category with higher homotopies, modelling homotopy theory.

children.name: Homotopy type theory
children.what: Type theory with identity types as paths, with univalent foundations.

children.name: Univalence axiom
children.what: Equivalent types are equal.

children.name: Monoidal and applied category theory
children.what: Categories with tensor products and applications.

children.name: Monoidal category
children.what: Category with an associative tensor product and unit.

children.name: Mac Lane's coherence theorem
children.what: All diagrams of associators and unitors commute.

children.name: Operad
children.what: Abstract algebra of operations with several inputs.

children.name: Type theory and logic in computation
children.what: Typed calculi, program semantics and proof assistants.

children.name: Simply typed lambda calculus
children.what: Typed lambda calculus with strong normalisation.

children.name: Martin-Löf type theory
children.what: Dependent type theory foundation for constructive mathematics.

children.name: Calculus of constructions
children.what: Dependent type theory behind Coq and Lean.

children.name: Formal proof verification
children.what: Machine-checked proofs.

children.name: Four colour theorem formalisation
children.what: Coq proof of the four colour theorem.

children.name: Kepler conjecture formalisation
children.what: Flyspeck project formalised Hales's proof in HOL Light and Isabelle.

children.name: Lean mathlib
children.what: Large community library of formalised mathematics.

nodes.name: Arithmetic and number theory
nodes.what: Properties of integers and their generalisations, from divisibility to modular forms and Diophantine equations.

children.name: Elementary number theory
children.what: Divisibility, congruences and arithmetic of integers.

children.name: Divisibility and gcd
children.what: Division, greatest common divisors, Bézout.

children.name: Euclidean algorithm
children.what: Computes gcd by repeated remainders.

children.name: Bézout's identity
children.what: gcd(a,b) is an integer combination of a and b.

children.name: Fundamental theorem of arithmetic
children.what: Every integer above 1 factors uniquely into primes.

children.name: Division algorithm
children.what: Every a = qb + r with 0 ≤ r < b.

children.name: Euclid's lemma
children.what: If a prime divides ab, it divides a or b.

children.name: Congruences
children.what: Arithmetic modulo n.

children.name: Chinese remainder theorem
children.what: Systems of congruences with coprime moduli have unique solutions mod the product.

children.name: Fermat's little theorem
children.what: a^p ≡ a (mod p) for prime p.

children.name: Euler's theorem
children.what: a^φ(n) ≡ 1 (mod n) when gcd(a,n)=1.

children.name: Wilson's theorem
children.what: (p−1)! ≡ −1 (mod p) iff p is prime.

children.name: Hensel's lemma
children.what: Lifts roots mod p to p-adic roots.

children.name: Primitive roots
children.what: Existence of a generator of the multiplicative group mod n for n = 1,2,4,p^k,2p^k.

children.name: Carmichael numbers
children.what: Composite n with a^(n−1) ≡ 1 mod n for all coprime a.

children.name: Infinitely many Carmichael numbers
children.what: There are infinitely many Carmichael numbers.

children.name: Arithmetic functions
children.what: Functions on the positive integers such as φ, σ, μ.

children.name: Euler totient function
children.what: Counts integers up to n coprime to n.

children.name: Divisor function σ
children.what: Sum of positive divisors of n.

children.name: Möbius function
children.what: Signed indicator of squarefree numbers.

children.name: Möbius inversion
children.what: Recovers f from its summatory function F(n) = Σ over d dividing n of f(d).

children.name: Dirichlet convolution
children.what: Product on arithmetic functions making them a ring.

children.name: Perfect and amicable numbers
children.what: Numbers equal to sums of their divisors.

children.name: Euclid–Euler theorem
children.what: Even perfect numbers correspond to Mersenne primes.

children.name: Odd perfect number problem
children.what: Does any odd perfect number exist?

children.name: Amicable numbers
children.what: Pairs where each is the sum of the other's proper divisors.

children.name: Quadratic residues
children.what: Squares modulo n.

children.name: Quadratic reciprocity
children.what: Links solvability of x² ≡ p mod q with x² ≡ q mod p.

children.name: Legendre symbol
children.what: Indicates whether a is a square mod an odd prime p.

children.name: Jacobi symbol
children.what: Generalisation of the Legendre symbol to odd composite moduli.

children.name: Euler's criterion
children.what: a is a QR mod p iff a^((p−1)/2) ≡ 1.

children.name: Tonelli–Shanks algorithm
children.what: Computes square roots modulo a prime.

children.name: Sums of squares
children.what: Which numbers are sums of squares.

children.name: Fermat's two-square theorem
children.what: An odd prime is a sum of two squares iff p ≡ 1 mod 4.

children.name: Lagrange's four-square theorem
children.what: Every natural number is a sum of four squares.

children.name: Legendre's three-square theorem
children.what: n is a sum of three squares iff it is not of form 4^a(8b+7).

children.name: Waring's problem
children.what: Every natural number is a sum of g(k) k-th powers; g(k) finite.

children.name: Pythagorean triples
children.what: Integer solutions of a² + b² = c².

children.name: Continued fractions
children.what: Representing reals as nested fractions.

children.name: Continued fraction expansion
children.what: Convergents give best rational approximations.

children.name: Lagrange's theorem on periodic continued fractions
children.what: Quadratic irrationals have eventually periodic expansions.

children.name: Pell's equation
children.what: x² − Dy² = 1 has infinitely many solutions for non-square D.

children.name: Diophantine approximation
children.what: Rational approximation of reals.

children.name: Dirichlet's approximation theorem
children.what: For any α, infinitely many p/q with abs(α − p/q) < 1/q².

children.name: Liouville's theorem on approximation
children.what: Algebraic numbers of degree n resist good rational approximation.

children.name: Roth's theorem
children.what: Algebraic irrationals have approximation exponent exactly 2.

children.name: Hurwitz's theorem
children.what: Every irrational has infinitely many p/q with error < 1/(√5 q²).

children.name: Primes
children.what: The building blocks of integers.

children.name: Basic results
children.what: Foundational facts about prime numbers.

children.name: Euclid's theorem on infinitude of primes
children.what: There are infinitely many primes.

children.name: Sieve of Eratosthenes
children.what: Finds all primes up to n by removing multiples.

children.name: Bertrand's postulate
children.what: For n>1 there is a prime between n and 2n.

children.name: Euler's divergence of prime reciprocals
children.what: Σ 1/p diverges.

children.name: Mersenne primes
children.what: Primes of the form 2^p − 1.

children.name: Fermat primes
children.what: Primes of form 2^(2^n)+1; only five known.

children.name: Gauss–Wantzel theorem
children.what: A regular n-gon is constructible iff n is a power of 2 times distinct Fermat primes.

children.name: Dirichlet's theorem on primes in arithmetic progressions
children.what: a + nd contains infinitely many primes if gcd(a,d)=1.

children.name: Green–Tao theorem
children.what: Primes contain arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions.

children.name: Chen's theorem
children.what: Every large even number is a prime plus a prime or semiprime.

children.name: Zhang's bounded gaps theorem
children.what: Infinitely many prime pairs differ by at most 70 million, later reduced to 246.

children.name: Maynard–Tao theorem
children.what: Bounded gaps between k primes among a set of linear forms.

children.name: Prime distribution
children.what: Asymptotic and analytic behaviour of primes.

children.name: Prime number theorem
children.what: The count of primes up to x is asymptotically x / ln x.

children.name: Chebyshev's bounds
children.what: π(x) is within constant multiples of x/ln x.

children.name: Elementary proof of the prime number theorem
children.what: Proof without complex analysis.

children.name: Mertens' theorems
children.what: Asymptotics of Σ 1/p and ∏(1−1/p).

children.name: Siegel–Walfisz theorem
children.what: Prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions with uniform error.

children.name: Bombieri–Vinogradov theorem
children.what: Primes in arithmetic progressions on average obey GRH-strength bound.

children.name: Maier's matrix method
children.what: Irregularity of primes in short intervals.

children.name: Hardy–Littlewood prime tuples conjecture
children.what: Predicts density of prime constellations.

children.name: Cramér's conjecture
children.what: Gaps between consecutive primes are O((log p)²).

children.name: Schinzel's hypothesis H
children.what: Polynomials simultaneously take prime values infinitely often.

children.name: Primality and factoring
children.what: Testing and factoring integers.

children.name: AKS primality test
children.what: Deterministic polynomial-time primality test.

children.name: Miller–Rabin test
children.what: Probabilistic primality test.

children.name: Solovay–Strassen test
children.what: Probabilistic primality test using the Jacobi symbol.

children.name: Lucas–Lehmer test
children.what: Deterministic test for Mersenne primes.

children.name: Pollard's rho
children.what: Factoring by cycle detection.

children.name: Quadratic sieve
children.what: Subexponential factoring algorithm.

children.name: Number field sieve
children.what: Fastest known classical factoring algorithm for large numbers.

children.name: Shor's algorithm
children.what: Polynomial-time quantum factoring.

children.name: Elliptic curve method
children.what: Factoring using elliptic curves.

children.name: Analytic number theory
children.what: Using complex analysis and estimates to study integers.

children.name: Zeta and L-functions
children.what: Generating functions encoding arithmetic.

children.name: Riemann zeta function
children.what: Analytic continuation of Σ n^(−s).

children.name: Euler product
children.what: ζ(s) as a product over primes.

children.name: Functional equation of zeta
children.what: Relates ζ(s) and ζ(1−s).

children.name: Basel problem
children.what: Σ 1/n² = π²/6.

children.name: Zeta at even integers
children.what: ζ(2k) is a rational multiple of π^(2k) via Bernoulli numbers.

children.name: Apéry's theorem
children.what: ζ(3) is irrational.

children.name: Dirichlet L-functions
children.what: Twisted zeta functions attached to characters.

children.name: Dedekind zeta function
children.what: Zeta function of a number field.

children.name: Class number formula
children.what: Residue of Dedekind zeta gives class number times regulator.

children.name: Dirichlet class number formula
children.what: Class number of quadratic fields via L(1,χ).

children.name: Hasse–Weil L-function
children.what: L-function of an algebraic variety.

children.name: Selberg class
children.what: Axiomatic class of L-functions.

children.name: Sieve methods
children.what: Counting integers avoiding prime divisors.

children.name: Brun's sieve
children.what: Shows the sum of twin prime reciprocals converges.

children.name: Selberg sieve
children.what: Upper-bound sieve using optimised quadratic forms.

children.name: Large sieve
children.what: Inequality bounding exponential sums over sparse sets.

children.name: Vinogradov's three-primes theorem
children.what: Every sufficiently large odd number is a sum of three primes.

children.name: Helfgott's proof of ternary Goldbach
children.what: Every odd number above 5 is a sum of three primes.

children.name: Circle and exponential sums
children.what: Hardy–Littlewood method and related tools.

children.name: Hardy–Littlewood circle method
children.what: Counts representations via Fourier analysis on the circle.

children.name: Weyl's inequality
children.what: Bounds exponential sums with polynomial phases.

children.name: Vinogradov mean value theorem
children.what: Optimal mean value estimates for Weyl sums.

children.name: Gauss sums
children.what: Exponential sums with quadratic character.

children.name: Kloosterman sums
children.what: Exponential sums involving inverses mod p; Weil bound.

children.name: Weil bound for Kloosterman sums
children.what: Kloosterman sum is bounded by 2√p.

children.name: Partitions and additive number theory
children.what: Representations of integers as sums.

children.name: Partition function
children.what: Number of ways to write n as sum of positive integers.

children.name: Rademacher's exact formula
children.what: Convergent series for p(n).

children.name: Szemerédi's theorem
children.what: Sets of positive density contain arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions.

children.name: Roth's theorem on arithmetic progressions
children.what: Dense sets contain three-term arithmetic progressions.

children.name: Freiman's theorem
children.what: Sets with small doubling are dense in generalised progressions.

children.name: Cauchy–Davenport theorem
children.what: Lower bound on size of sumsets mod p.

children.name: Multiplicative functions and Dirichlet series
children.what: Analytic study of arithmetic functions.

children.name: Erdős–Kac theorem
